subject: Orsen Financial — activation matrix and MVP tradeoffs
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@orsen.com>, Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@orsen.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orsen Financial — activation matrix and MVP tradeoffs

Hi team,

Following our discovery call with Orsen today, they have machine-translation-like workloads and an enterprise compliance bar that forces a phased activation. They want to go-live with a limited set of features on 2026-10-15, and will expand to full audit/export requirements later. I need product/engineering alignment on what we can safely deliver for an MVP vs. what needs to be scoped out to Q1.

High-level asks from Orsen (attached matrix):
- Tenant-level model pinning (per-customer model version so they can certify outputs) — high priority for legal.
- Per-route / per-tenant audit export (daily exports, retention = 3 years) — compliance asks; may be phased.
- KV cache seeding / warmup for predictable latency on peak windows (batch pre-warm).
- SLA: 99.9 P95 latency target for the main inference route.
- Fine-grained routing control to route traffic to a lower-capacity fallback model during bursts.

Questions for Product/Eng:
1) Which of the above can we realistically commit to for an Oct 15 MVP if we can allocate a single feature sprint + 2 devs full-time?
2) For items we cannot do, can we supply a documented temporary workaround (staging pin, manual export delivery, cache pre-warm script run by CS)?
3) Rough ETA and risk notes (regressions, infra impact).

Ethan is flexible with scope but firm on launch date for a pilot with a subset of customers. Please review the attached matrix (Orsen_MVP_requirement_matrix.xlsx) and reply with a suggested MVP bundle and recommended timeline.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@orsen.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orsen Financial — activation matrix and MVP tradeoffs

Thanks Priyom — read the matrix and high level notes. I'll be direct to make the decision path clear for the product committee: we should aim for a minimal, low-risk MVP that prevents legal/regulatory roadblocks and defers heavy infra work to a follow-on sprint.

Proposed MVP bundle (minimal):
- Tenant-level model pinning: lightweight enforcement at the routing layer (no per-tenant persisted model bundles; pin via config + audit log) — allows Orsen to lock model version for traffic.
- Manual daily export for first 90 days delivered by CS (CSV/JSON schema) — automated export postponed to post-MVP.
- Cache warmup script as a CS-run operational step (not automated); provide runbook and tooling to seed hot keys.
- SLA: offer a staged SLA statement that guarantees best-effort latency and a performance review at 30 days; hard 99.9 SLAs require infra validation and capacity reservation.

Open questions I need answered before committing to Oct 15:
- Does Orsen require automated, audited export for day one (legal might insist). If so, we cannot hit Oct 15 without deprioritizing something else.
- Can we accept a manual export for initial pilot?

Ben — can you provide quick feasibility comments (effort estimates) on the three technical bullets above? Kimberly / Marissa — FYI on negotiation and commercial risk. If product committee approves the minimal bundle, I'll draft a decision memo for the 9/13 product sync.

—Jasmine
Product Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@orsen.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orsen Financial — activation matrix and MVP tradeoffs

Jasmine — quick technical read below from infra/serving perspective. High level: we can split into "low-effort" and "high-effort" items for Oct 15.

Low effort (1–2 engineers, 1 sprint each)
- Config-driven model pinning at routing layer: ~2 weeks (routing + small config UI/API). No storage migration required; we store pin in tenant config. Risk: no full end-to-end certification workflow, but satisfies immediate ask.
- Cache warmup runbook + tooling: ~1 week (script + docs) if we rely on CS to run in prod; adding lightweight API to trigger seeding adds another week.

High effort (3–5 engineer-weeks)
- Automated per-tenant daily export with 3-year retention: medium complexity. Needs export pipeline, retention policy plumbing, and S3 lifecycle + access controls. Estimate: 3–4 weeks (2 engineers) to implement reliable export + delivery integration.
- 99.9 SLA guarantee: requires capacity reservation / dedicated pool or conservative throttling policies and testing. Depends on whether customer accepts a soft-SLA. Reserving dedicated capacity is separate commercial work with infra provisioning lead time (2–4 weeks to reserve and validate).

Fallback plan for Oct 15 (if we lock to MVP bundle):
- Implement model pinning (routing config) + cache script + manual exports.
- Provide an explicit MoM and runbook for CS to perform daily exports until automation is landed.

Risks: manual export increases operational load and human error surface; cache warmup is a stopgap and may not fully prevent cold-start P95 spikes for very large sequences. We should also confirm audit log retention location (their auditors may require access patterns).

Happy to sync with the infra PI lead tomorrow and give a more detailed sprint plan.

—Ben
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

From: Ethan Ross <ethan.ross@orsen.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@orsen.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orsen Financial — activation matrix and MVP tradeoffs

Thanks, all. Short answer: we can accept the manual export and the routing-config pin for MVP as long as we get a firm date for automated exports and confirmed retention commitments. The launch date is driven by a client pilot event on Oct 15 — that's not flexible.

Acceptable for MVP:
- Config-based model pinning (we understand it is not the full certification flow).
- Manual daily export delivered by CS for first 60 days; please include a sample schema so our auditors can pre-approve.
- Cache warmup runbook — we'll have an Orsen infra engineer run the first two warmups with Redwood to validate.

Requests (must be scheduled):
1) Automated export delivery with 3-year retention: target completion by 2026-11-30.
2) A commitment note on SLA posture by 2026-09-20 (even if staged).

We are prepared to sign a pilot addendum contingent on the above schedule. I'll share the auditor contact after internal confirmation.

—Ethan Ross
Head of Platform Partnerships, Orsen Financial
ethan.ross@orsen.com

Subject: Re: Orsen Financial — activation matrix and MVP tradeoffs

Thanks everyone — summarizing agreed plan and next steps (attaching MoM):

Agreed MVP (target launch 2026-10-15):
- Implement config-based tenant model pinning (Ben: 2 weeks).
- Provide cache warmup script + runbook; CS + Orsen to run first warmups (Ben: 1 week).
- CS to deliver manual daily export for initial 60–90 days; provide sample schema to Orsen this week.
- Product to provide staged SLA note by 2026-09-20 (Jasmine).

Committed follow-ups:
- Automated daily export + retention policy (3 years) to be delivered by 2026-11-30 (Product + Eng).
- Capacity / dedicated pool decision if we need hard 99.9 SLA — commercial discussion with Marissa.

Actions: 
- Ben: send a short sprint plan and PRD by 2026-09-17 (includes effort breakdown and test plan).
- Jasmine: prepare decision memo for product sync 2026-09-13 (we need sign-off for MVP bundle).
- Marissa: confirm commercial language and how dedicated capacity pricing will be presented in the pilot addendum.
- Priyom: send pilot addendum draft to Orsen after product sync.

Attachments: Orsen_MVP_requirement_matrix.xlsx; Orsen_MoM_20260911.pdf

If there's anything I've missed, flag it here. Otherwise I'll take this into the product sync and then loop back with the pilot addendum.

Best,
Priyom
